summary: Self-improving agent loop that autonomously runs ML experiments overnight, commits improvements that beat baseline, and rolls back failures. Ran 700 experiments in 2 days, cutting benchmark time 11%.
relevanceToAgentForge: Medium — AgentForge already ships skill distillation (distillationAgent.ts) and run-outcome skills via agentSkillRepository.ts. The keep/rollback loop is specific to ML training, not code orchestration. Core self-improvement concept partially covered by existing skill distillation.

summary: Runtime multi-model orchestration for Copilot choosing single-model, cascade, or critique workflows per task at inference time. Cuts cost 65-67% vs. Opus 5 alone on benchmarks while matching or beating quality.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — AgentForge already ships role-tier model routing (agentModels.ts). Multi-model critique panels were explicitly evaluated and rejected as a cost multiplier (Phase 2 limitation note 7). Backlog also at cap.

summary: Open-source Python SDK giving LangGraph agents semantic, episodic, and procedural long-term memory across conversations. The three-layer model (semantic/episodic/procedural) is the recommended pattern for 2026.
relevanceToAgentForge: Medium — AgentForge ships procedural memory (skill distillation). Episodic memory is already tracked by open issue HID-188; this source does not add capability beyond what HID-188 specifies.

source: Socratic-SWE: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Trace-Derived Agent Skills
summary: Closed-loop framework distilling Agent Skill Registries from historical traces, targeting recurring failure patterns. Uses execution-based validation of extracted skills. Reaches 50.4% SWE-bench Verified after 3 self-evolution iterations.
relevanceToAgentForge: High — directly mirrors AgentForge's distillationAgent.ts but adds: (1) failure-pattern targeting in skill extraction, (2) execution-based skill validation, (3) iterative re-distillation loop. Could meaningfully improve distillation quality. Could not evaluate for issue this run — backlog at cap (11 open issues ≥ 10 threshold).

summary: Community fork of AutoGen with async event-driven architecture, multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama). v1.0 beta released with streaming event loop replacing synchronous conversation loop.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — AgentForge uses its own TypeScript orchestration stack and CLI subprocess agents. AG2 is Python-based; no directly adoptable patterns.

summary: Framework distinguishing vibe coding from agentic engineering: spec design, diff review, eval loops, security boundaries. Advocates for developer-maintained conceptual ownership across agent-driven changes.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — conceptual alignment with AgentForge's design philosophy, no specific implementable capability gap identified.

source: Microsoft Agent Framework v1.0 GA (Semantic Kernel + AutoGen)
summary: Microsoft combined Semantic Kernel and AutoGen into a unified enterprise agent platform reaching v1.0 GA on April 2, 2026. Python/.NET ecosystem, enterprise focus.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — Python/.NET ecosystem; AgentForge is TypeScript. No adoptable capability gap.

source: Agentic Software Engineering: Foundational Pillars and a Research Roadmap (arXiv 2509.06216)
summary: Survey paper outlining foundational pillars and research roadmap for agentic software engineering as of September 2026. Covers planning, memory, tool use, and multi-agent coordination.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — survey paper with no specific implementable pattern above what AgentForge already does.
